reasons: Datadog sums nginx.net.reading across all matching series, but the candidate uses avg(), which returns the average per series instead of the total connections reading.
The $Host template variable has tag prefix host and default *, so it should become a host label matcher (e.g. host=~"$host"). The candidate drops it, so the series set is not filtered the same way.
The metric is a non-monotonic sum of current connections, so no rate() is needed and the quantity and unit (connections) match.
Outcome translated is appropriate because no Datadog function is used and an OTel metric measures the same quantity.
